scenarios.name: Fault Lines 2025
scenarios.blurb: The world as it stands: great-power rivalry, an ongoing war in Eastern Europe, fragile energy markets and ageing societies. Lead your nation to lasting standing.

scenarios.name: A Quiet Decade 2025
scenarios.blurb: No wars are underway, though rivalries simmer. A sandbox for economic, diplomatic and scientific play, where peace has to be kept.

scenarios.name: Energy Crunch 2025
scenarios.blurb: A supply shock has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher and tightened the Hormuz lane. Watch inflation, elections and alliances strain.
